title: Architecture hub triage: reconcile contracts with built code (v1.2.0)
acceptance: Every contract-change message in org/hubs/architecture.jsonl has a decision (accept/reject/modify) and exactly one type=answer post to the architecture hub with --to the requester; the decision list is returned in the ticket result.

openapi.yaml version is 1.2.0 and parses (node script using a YAML parser or existing repo validator); all architecture/contracts/**/*.json parse with JSON.parse; org/contracts/registry.json parses and entries for changed contracts are bumped (openapi 1.2.0, coverage module 1.1.0, others as changed).

openapi: roles tenant_admin, auditor, carrier_admin documented; POST /auth/token returns 201 {token, expiresAt, principal}; channel enum includes csr_phone etc.; IntakeStep has prompt, locale, optional[], missing[] of {questionId,text}; POST /intake/sessions/{id}/narrative exists; GET /policies?q= returns PolicySummary[] with search by name/postal code/VIN/phone/policy number prefix; GET /api/v1/kpis returns {period, metrics:[{id,label,valueDriver,value,unit,numerator,denominator}]} with schemas.

Domain schemas: Document.extraction.needsReview, TriageResult.subrogation.confidence, AdjusterView derived flags and nextActions, CoverageVerification additive fields (status, deductible, limits, applicableCoverages), x-pii on Location.description and Location.geo are present and keep additionalProperties rules valid.
Events: claim.updated event schema added with envelope refs; no PII in payload.

modules.md: coverage 1.1.0 (seedPolicies, getSnapshotById, coverage_policies table), outbox sequence (per-tenant monotonic), rules routing precedence wording and examples (first route_queue by ascending priority wins; fast track conditions), severity band cut-offs per ADR-003; domain-model.md section 4 no longer says last route_queue wins.
Only files inside the ticket paths are modified; no package.json or src changes.
brief: Read all messages in org/hubs/architecture.jsonl (node org/cli.mjs hub architecture). For each contract-change message decide accept/reject/modify; prefer making contracts describe what the code does when the change is reasonable and additive; do not re-decide ADRs. Verify against code where unsure (src/core/auth.mjs ROLES, src/modules/*/service.mjs and routes) by reading, not editing. Work through: (1) openapi.yaml: roles, /auth/token 201 shape and userId/displayName request (core accepts sub/name as aliases; document), channel enum, IntakeStep additions (prompt, locale, optional[], missing[] with {questionId,text}, blocked[]), narrative endpoint, GET /policies?q=, GET /kpis with KPI schema (valueDriver ties to product value drivers), /healthz vs /health per core, bump info.version to 1.2.0. (2) domain schemas: needsReview, subrogation.confidence (0-1), AdjusterView flags/nextActions (items carry priority, source), CoverageVerification additive fields, x-pii on Location.description and Location.geo, PolicySummary and Kpi schemas. (3) events: claim.updated {claimId, change, version, ids} plus registry entry. (4) modules.md: coverage 1.1.0, outbox sequence, rules sync/async notes and routing precedence with 2-3 worked examples, ADR-003 severity cut-offs. (5) domain-model.md section 4 and overview.md corrections (ciphertext key id wording: state what crypto.mjs actually does). Reject or defer items that need platform code changes and are security-only (e.g. enc:v2 key ids, pay timer kind) but say so in the answer, with the smallest compatible addition. Security-defect items (tenant filter) are not contract matters: reject and refer to platform. Validate: node -e parse every JSON; parse openapi with whatever YAML parser the repo already uses (check existing tests under tests/ for a contract validation test and run only that). Post one answer per request: AGENT_ID=ic-architecture-api-designer node org/cli.mjs post architecture answer "..." --to <requester> --ticket S2-ARC-01. Pitfalls: schemas use additionalProperties:false, so every new field must be added explicitly; keep versions and registry in sync; synthetic data only.

verdicts.reason: 25 contract-change msgs each answered once to requester; openapi 1.2.0 + all contract JSON parse; registry bumped; domain/event/modules/domain-model updates verified; only contract/architecture paths changed
